topics.purpose: Define portfolio descriptions, tags, categories, public/private visibility and publication state as metadata independent from verification and MeritCore calculation.

semantics.verification_rule: Public visibility does not imply verified competence.
semantics.ranking_rule: Portfolio ordering/presentation is not competence ranking unless explicit projection says so.
semantics.authority_rule: Public item grants no source mutation rights.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.

references.purpose: Visibility applies to exact portfolio items.
